name: get_curriculum
description: Load a curriculum file so Alice can reference its content during conversation. Returns the parsed frontmatter and full markdown body of the requested level. Use this to ground your delivery in the authored curriculum rather than improvising content.

level.description: Which curriculum file to load. Valid values: 'preamble', 'belt-0a', 'belt-0b', 'belt-0c', '00', '01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06', '07', '08', '09', '10', '11', '12'.
